events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, with geopolitical instability and strategic rivalries increasing. The US has shown military strength, but its waning geopolitical power is a concern. The conflict has become a war of military, economy, and geopolitics.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation will lead to increased volatility in the markets, with gold being a safe-haven asset. The emerging markets will likely be negatively impacted by the conflict.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or when the gold price reaches $1800
